addresses.name: CCancelMovementCommand::Execute
addresses.comment: Slot 6. Looks the unit up by the id at +0x40 (FindPersistentById), keeps it at +0x3C, and calls **CUnit::CancelMovement(unit, true)** - so a halt also gives the unit a null order, takes it out of every battle it is attacking in, empties its path and loses its progress, and on enemy ground looks for a battle. Slot 7 answers the command's type, 0x263. Posted by a click on the unit's own province and by the unit panel's cancel_order_button for a land unit with a path that is not retreating. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-movement.md, section 4.
